blocks.zh: Section 2: Regulatory Considerations Part 1｜法規考量（上）：流程描述、控制策略、批次
blocks.en: Section 2: Regulatory Considerations Part 1 - Process Description, Control Strategy, Batch

blocks.zh: 第4節 法規考量：概述
blocks.en: Section 4 Regulatory Considerations: Overview

blocks.zh: 核心原則
blocks.en: Core Principle

blocks.zh: ICH Q13 的法規考量章節核心：連續製造的申請資料檔案（dossier）仍須遵循 ICH M4Q（CTD 的品質部分格式要求），但需額外補充 CM 特定的資訊。
blocks.en: The core of the Regulatory Considerations section of ICH Q13: the dossier for continuous manufacturing must still follow ICH M4Q (the format requirements for the quality part of the CTD), but must be supplemented with CM-specific information.

blocks.zh: 本節 §4.1–§4.10 逐一說明各 CTD 章節中應如何反映 CM 特性，以確保審查委員能完整了解控制策略設計。
blocks.en: §4.1 to §4.10 of this section explain, CTD section by CTD section, how the characteristics of CM should be reflected, so that reviewers can fully understand the design of the control strategy.

blocks.zh: 學習架構提示
blocks.en: Study Framework Tip

blocks.zh: 可將第4節理解為「CM 版 CTD 填寫指南」：哪個章節要放什麼 CM 特有資訊，§4.10 的 Table 1 則是總整理表。
blocks.en: Section 4 can be read as a "CM edition of the CTD completion guide": which section should contain which CM-specific information, with Table 1 in §4.10 serving as the overall summary table.

blocks.zh: §4.1 製造流程描述與製程控制
blocks.en: §4.1 Description of Manufacturing Process and Process Controls
CTD location: 3.2.S.2.2 / 3.2.P.3.3

blocks.zh: 傳統批次製造在此章節已有標準格式；CM 需在此基礎上「追加」以下 CM 專屬資訊：
blocks.en: Traditional batch manufacturing already has a standard format for this section; CM needs to "add" the following CM-specific information on top of it:

blocks.zh: CM 流程示意圖必備要素
blocks.en: Essential elements of a CM process flow diagram

blocks.zh: 與傳統批次相比，CM 的 flow diagram 需額外標示：
blocks.en: Compared with batch manufacturing, the CM flow diagram needs to additionally indicate:

blocks.zh: 物料進出點：原料投入點、中間體分流點、成品收集點、廢料排出點
blocks.en: Material entry and exit points: raw material input points, intermediate diversion points, product collection points, waste discharge points

blocks.zh: 單元操作序列：包含 surge tanks、緩衝線（buffer lines）
blocks.en: Sequence of unit operations: including surge tanks and buffer lines

blocks.zh: 物料流向箭頭：連續流 vs. 批次步驟需明確區分
blocks.en: Material flow arrows: continuous flow vs. batch steps must be clearly distinguished

blocks.zh: 製程控制位置：PAT 感測器位置、feedforward/feedback 控制點
blocks.en: Process control locations: PAT sensor locations, feedforward/feedback control points

blocks.zh: 考試重點
blocks.en: Exam Focus

blocks.zh: §4.1 要求描述的「物料轉向策略」與 §3.1.1 的科學設計原則一脈相承：CTD 中的策略說明必須與控制策略的科學依據一致。
blocks.en: The "material diversion strategy" that §4.1 requires to be described follows directly from the scientific design principles in §3.1.1: the strategy explained in the CTD must be consistent with the scientific basis of the control strategy.

blocks.zh: 思考問題
blocks.en: Discussion Question

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CM 的流程示意圖需要標示「continuous 與 batch 步驟的明確區分」？
blocks.en: Why does the CM flow diagram need to show "a clear distinction between continuous and batch steps"?

blocks.zh: 解答
blocks.en: Answer

blocks.zh: 許多 CM 系統並非全段連續，可能含有批次式步驟（如終端滅菌、灌裝）。審查員需清楚識別哪些步驟屬於連續製造的 RTD 影響範圍，以正確評估控制策略的適用性。
blocks.en: Many CM systems are not continuous end to end and may contain batch-type steps (such as terminal sterilization and filling). The reviewer needs to identify clearly which steps fall within the scope of RTD influence of the continuous manufacturing, in order to correctly assess the applicability of the control strategy.

blocks.zh: §4.2 控制策略
blocks.en: §4.2 Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 控制策略五大組成要素（CTD中需描述）
blocks.en: Five main components of the control strategy (to be described in the CTD)

blocks.zh: 資料平均化的關鍵警示
blocks.en: Key warning on data averaging

blocks.zh: Q13 明確指出：不應對整個 CM 運行時間的資料進行平均。應依「時間區間」平均，且該區間必須考量 PAT 量測頻率與 RTD 的相關性。
blocks.en: Q13 states explicitly that data should not be averaged over the entire CM run time. Averaging should be done by "time interval", and the interval must take into account the PAT measurement frequency and its relationship to the RTD.

blocks.zh: 原因：CM 過程中干擾事件（disturbance）可能只影響特定時段的物料，若對全程平均，將稀釋局部異常信號，掩蓋品質問題。
blocks.en: Reason: a disturbance during CM may affect only the material in a specific time period; averaging over the whole run would dilute the local abnormal signal and mask the quality problem.

blocks.zh: 物料轉向策略設計要素
blocks.en: Design elements of a material diversion strategy

blocks.zh: 設計安全的轉向策略需考量：
blocks.en: Designing a safe diversion strategy requires consideration of:

blocks.zh: RTD 的不確定性：轉向範圍需包含 RTD 預測的上下限加上安全邊際
blocks.en: RTD uncertainty: the diversion range must include the upper and lower limits of the RTD prediction plus a safety margin

blocks.zh: 干擾傳播：干擾信號可能沿系統下游傳播，需追蹤振幅與持續時間
blocks.en: Disturbance propagation: a disturbance signal may propagate downstream through the system, so its amplitude and duration need to be tracked

blocks.zh: 取樣頻率：決定「最早何時可確認品質恢復正常」
blocks.en: Sampling frequency: determines "the earliest time at which the return of quality to normal can be confirmed"

blocks.zh: 比喻：轉向策略如同交通管制
blocks.en: Analogy: a diversion strategy is like traffic control

blocks.zh: 想像高速公路上發生事故（干擾），不只關閉事故當下的車道，還需管制前後一段距離（RTD範圍＋安全邊際）的交通流量。「恢復通車」需等確認事故完全排除後，不能只看即時路況。
blocks.en: Imagine an accident (disturbance) on a highway. Not only is the lane at the accident site closed, but traffic is also controlled for some distance before and after it (RTD range + safety margin). "Reopening to traffic" waits until the accident is confirmed to be completely cleared; you cannot rely on the real-time traffic situation alone.

blocks.zh: RTRT的重要澄清
blocks.en: Important clarification on RTRT

blocks.zh: RTRT 不是 CM 的法規要求，而是可選工具。但若申請採用 RTRT，必須：
blocks.en: RTRT is not a regulatory requirement for CM; it is an optional tool. However, if an application adopts RTRT, it must:

blocks.zh: 說明參考測試方法（reference test method）
blocks.en: Describe the reference test method

blocks.zh: 評估資料收集中斷（如重新校正 NIR 探頭）對品質決策的影響
blocks.en: Assess the impact on quality decisions of interruptions in data collection (such as recalibration of the NIR probe)

blocks.zh: 提出替代或額外的品質控制措施作為備援
blocks.en: Propose alternative or additional quality control measures as a backup

blocks.zh: CTD 控制策略摘要位置
blocks.en: Location of the control strategy summary in the CTD

blocks.zh: 完整的控制策略必須在以下章節提供摘要，並交叉引用詳細資訊：
blocks.en: The complete control strategy must be summarized in the following sections, with cross-references to the detailed information:

blocks.zh: 3.2.S.2.6（藥物物質製造開發）
blocks.en: 3.2.S.2.6 (drug substance manufacturing development)

blocks.zh: 3.2.P.2.3（藥品開發，製造開發部分）
blocks.en: 3.2.P.2.3 (drug product development, manufacturing development part)

blocks.zh: 摘要需提供「連結或引用」其他 CTD 章節中的詳細資訊，以便審查員追蹤驗證。
blocks.en: The summary needs to provide "links or references" to the detailed information in other CTD sections so that the reviewer can trace and verify it.

blocks.zh: §4.3 批次描述與批量
blocks.en: §4.3 Description of Batch and Batch Size

blocks.zh: 批量申請的三層架構
blocks.en: Three-tier structure of a batch size application

blocks.zh: 批次一致性量化指標
blocks.en: Quantitative metric for batch consistency

blocks.zh: Q13 要求在 PQS 中定義定量指標（quantitative metric）加上驗收標準，以評估批次間一致性。
blocks.en: Q13 requires a quantitative metric plus acceptance criteria to be defined in the PQS to assess batch-to-batch consistency.

blocks.zh: 範例：當批量以「收集物料量」定義時，每批的「轉向物料量 ÷ 收集物料量」比率應在 PQS 中設定可接受範圍，作為系統穩健性的指標。
blocks.en: Example: when batch size is defined as "quantity of material collected", the ratio of "quantity of material diverted / quantity of material collected" for each batch should have an acceptable range set in the PQS, as an indicator of system robustness.

blocks.zh: 為何 Q13 要求「每批製造開始前，應先確定該批次的預計批量」（intended size defined before manufacturing begins）？
blocks.en: Why does Q13 require that "the intended size of each batch be defined before manufacturing begins" (intended size defined before manufacturing begins)?

blocks.zh: CM 系統的批量與運行時間或質量流率直接相關。預先確定批量才能：(1) 正確設定運行時間；(2) 確保轉向策略的安全邊際計算基準一致；(3) 滿足後續批次記錄的完整性要求。
blocks.en: The batch size of a CM system is directly related to run time or mass flow rate. Defining the batch size in advance makes it possible to: (1) set the run time correctly; (2) ensure a consistent basis for calculating the safety margin of the diversion strategy; (3) meet the completeness requirements of the subsequent batch records.

blocks.zh: §4.4 製程模型
blocks.en: §4.4 Process Models

blocks.zh: 模型申報的核心原則：與影響類別相稱
blocks.en: Core principle of model submission: commensurate with impact category

blocks.zh: 申報資料中對模型的詳細程度，應與以下兩個面向相稱（commensurate）：
blocks.en: The level of detail for a model in the submission should be commensurate with the following two aspects:

blocks.zh: 模型類型：理論機理模型 vs. 資料驅動模型 vs. 混合模型
blocks.en: Model type: theoretical mechanistic model vs. data-driven model vs. hybrid model

blocks.zh: 影響類別：僅用於開發階段 vs. 商業製造中的控制策略組成 vs. RTRT 的基礎
blocks.en: Impact category: used only in the development stage vs. a component of the control strategy in commercial manufacturing vs. the basis of RTRT

blocks.zh: 模型的系統特異性要求
blocks.en: System-specificity requirement for models

blocks.zh: 製程模型必須針對特定系統（specific for the defined system）建立，包含設備、配置（layout）、連接方式（connections）。
blocks.en: A process model must be built for the specific system (specific for the defined system), including the equipment, layout, and connections.

blocks.zh: 實務含義：若製造廠的設備配置改變，模型需重新評估，不能直接移植。這是技術轉移時的重要考量點。
blocks.en: Practical implication: if the equipment configuration at the manufacturing site changes, the model needs to be re-evaluated and cannot simply be transferred. This is an important consideration in technology transfer.

blocks.zh: 法規期望（依模型影響層級）
blocks.en: Regulatory expectations (by model impact level)

blocks.zh:
高影響（High-impact 模型，如 RTRT 基礎）：
  → 完整驗證資料（3.2.R 區域資訊章節）
  → 詳細說明 + 驗收標準
  → 現場稽核時須可查

低影響（如開發工具）：
  → 模型類型說明 + 用途描述
  → 維護計畫概述
  → 不要求完整驗證資料
blocks.en:
High-impact model (such as the basis of RTRT):
  → Full validation data (3.2.R regional information section)
  → Detailed description + acceptance criteria
  → Must be available during on-site inspection

Low-impact (such as a development tool):
  → Description of model type + description of intended use
  → Overview of the maintenance plan
  → Full validation data not required

blocks.zh: 參考文件
blocks.en: Reference document

blocks.zh: Q13 在模型議題上直接引用「ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 實施指引（Points to Consider）」，說明製程模型的詳細法規期望已在 ICH 體系中另有規範，Q13 不重複撰寫。
blocks.en: On the topic of models, Q13 directly refers to the "ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 Implementation Working Group Points to Consider", which shows that the detailed regulatory expectations for process models are already set out elsewhere in the ICH system, and Q13 does not repeat them.

blocks.zh: §4.5 藥物物質與藥品穩定性
blocks.en: §4.5 Stability of Drug Substance and Drug Product

blocks.zh: CM 穩定性的基本原則
blocks.en: Basic principles of CM stability

blocks.zh: 總體要求與批次製造相同：依 ICH Q1A（化學藥物）和 ICH Q5C（生物藥物）執行。主要穩定性批次（primary stability batches）必須使用「具代表性的商業製造流程與設備」生產。
blocks.en: The overall requirements are the same as for batch manufacturing: follow ICH Q1A (chemical drugs) and ICH Q5C (biological drugs). Primary stability batches must be manufactured using "a representative commercial manufacturing process and equipment".

blocks.zh: CM 的穩定性批次三個特別彈性
blocks.en: Three special flexibilities for CM stability batches

blocks.zh: 增產方式對穩定性批次的影響
blocks.en: Impact of the output-increase approach on stability batches

blocks.zh: 若採用「非延長運行時間」的增產方式（如放大設備尺寸 scale-up、並聯設備 scale-out），申請者需另行合理說明如何定義主要穩定性批次，並建議事先與主管機關溝通策略。
blocks.en: If an output-increase approach other than "extended run time" is adopted (such as scaling up the equipment size or scale-out with parallel equipment), the applicant must provide a separate justification of how the primary stability batches are defined, and it is recommended to discuss the strategy with the regulatory authority in advance.

blocks.zh: 原因：設備尺寸改變後，RTD、混合特性等均可能不同，不能直接推論較小規模的穩定性數據可代表商業批次。
blocks.en: Reason: once the equipment size changes, the RTD, mixing characteristics, and so on may differ, so it cannot be directly inferred that stability data from a smaller scale are representative of commercial batches.

blocks.zh: 為何 Q13 允許用「較短製造時間的批次」做穩定性試驗，但要求「必須另行證明較長商業運行時間下仍維持受控狀態」？兩者之間是否矛盾？
blocks.en: Why does Q13 allow stability studies to use "batches with a shorter manufacturing time" but require that "maintenance of the state of control over the longer commercial run time must be demonstrated separately"? Is there a contradiction between the two?

blocks.zh: 不矛盾。穩定性試驗評估的是「產品本身的化學/物理/生物穩定性」，這可由較短批次反映；而「較長運行時間下的受控狀態」評估的是「製造穩健性」，需透過製程驗證或 CPV 數據另行證明。兩者評估目的不同，分開要求符合科學邏輯。
blocks.en: There is no contradiction. A stability study evaluates "the chemical/physical/biological stability of the product itself", which can be reflected by shorter batches; whereas "the state of control over a longer run time" evaluates "manufacturing robustness", which must be demonstrated separately through process validation or CPV data. The two have different evaluation purposes, so requiring them separately is scientifically logical.

blocks.zh: §4.10 CTD 中 CM 特定資訊的申報
blocks.en: §4.10 Submission of CM-Specific Information in the CTD

blocks.zh: 整合型 CM 流程的特殊處理
blocks.en: Special handling of integrated CM processes

blocks.zh: 當藥物物質（DS）與藥品（DP）的 CM 製造流程相整合時（即「DS → DP 全連續」），部分資訊（如整合流程示意圖）可統一放在 3.2.P 章節，並在 3.2.S 中以交叉引用方式指向。詳見 Annex IV。
blocks.en: When the CM manufacturing processes of the drug substance (DS) and the drug product (DP) are integrated (that is, "fully continuous DS → DP"), some information (such as the integrated process flow diagram) can be placed together in section 3.2.P and cross-referenced from 3.2.S. See Annex IV for details.

blocks.zh: Table 1 解讀：CM 特定資訊在 CTD 的分布全圖
blocks.en: Interpreting Table 1: the full map of where CM-specific information sits in the CTD

blocks.zh: Table 1 使用指引
blocks.en: Guide to using Table 1

blocks.zh: Table 1 是 Q13 的核心申報路線圖，將 CM 特定資訊映射至標準 CTD 章節。以下提供各 CTD 章節的學習重點：
blocks.en: Table 1 is the core submission roadmap of Q13, mapping CM-specific information to the standard CTD sections. The key learning points for each CTD section are provided below:
3.2.S.2.6 / 3.2.P.2.3: Process development summary

blocks.zh: 此章節是控制策略的「總目錄」，需提供：
blocks.en: This section is the "table of contents" of the control strategy and needs to provide:

blocks.zh: 整體製程開發摘要
blocks.en: Overall process development summary

blocks.zh: 控制策略摘要＋合理性說明
blocks.en: Control strategy summary + justification

blocks.zh: 通往各詳細章節的「連結地圖」
blocks.en: A "link map" to each of the detailed sections

blocks.zh: 考試重點：模型說明、RTD 資訊、批量範圍合理性均在此章節提供摘要。
blocks.en: Exam focus: summaries of the model description, RTD information, and the justification of the batch size range are all provided in this section.
3.2.S.2.4 / 3.2.P.3.4: Controls of critical steps

blocks.zh: 這是「過去傳統批次就有」的章節，但 CM 版本需額外包含：
blocks.en: This is a section that "already existed in traditional batch manufacturing", but the CM version needs to additionally include:

blocks.zh: 製程模型的應用參數與驗收標準
blocks.en: Application parameters and acceptance criteria of the process model

blocks.zh: 模型不可用時的應急計畫（contingency plan）
blocks.en: Contingency plan for when the model is unavailable

blocks.zh: 主動製程控制（active process controls）的可接受限度
blocks.en: Acceptable limits for active process controls

blocks.zh: 3.2.R（區域資訊）：高影響模型的驗證資料
blocks.en: 3.2.R (regional information): validation data for high-impact models

blocks.zh: 高影響製程模型的驗證資料（validation data）放在 3.2.R（Region-specific information），而非主文件。這意味著不同地區可能有不同的提交要求。
blocks.en: The validation data for a high-impact process model are placed in 3.2.R (Region-specific information) rather than in the main document. This means that different regions may have different submission requirements.

blocks.zh: 連續製程查驗（CPV scheme）也在此提交，反映 CPV 在各地區尚有不同監管實踐。
blocks.en: The continuous process verification (CPV scheme) is also submitted here, reflecting that regulatory practice for CPV still differs between regions.

blocks.zh: 模型資訊 CTD 放置原則（#注腳）
blocks.en: CTD placement principles for model information (# footnote)

Model use                                  → Submission location
─────────────────────────────────────
Used for drug substance release testing    → 3.2.S.4
Used for in-process testing                → 3.2.S.2.4 / 3.2.P.3.4
Used for in-process testing + RTRT         → 3.2.S.4 or 3.2.P.5
                                             (cross-reference 3.2.S.2.4/3.2.P.3.4)
Used for process development only          → 3.2.S.2.6 / 3.2.P.2.3

blocks.zh: 綜合練習問題
blocks.en: Comprehensive Practice Question

blocks.zh: 一個 CM 系統使用 NIR 光譜模型進行即時放行試驗（RTRT）。請問此 NIR 模型的相關資訊應申報在 CTD 的哪個章節？需包含哪些內容？
blocks.en: A CM system uses an NIR spectroscopic model for real-time release testing (RTRT). In which CTD section should the information on this NIR model be submitted? What should it include?

blocks.zh: 依 Table 1 及 # 注腳：
blocks.en: According to Table 1 and the # footnote:

blocks.zh: （藥物物質/藥品管制章節）：
blocks.en: (drug substance/drug product control sections):

blocks.zh: 模型摘要與合理性說明，及取樣策略
blocks.en: Model summary and justification, and sampling strategy

blocks.zh: NIR 探頭資料中斷時的應急測試計畫
blocks.en: Contingency testing plan for when NIR probe data are interrupted

blocks.zh: 分析模型驗證資訊
blocks.en: Analytical model validation information

blocks.zh: 3.2.S.2.6 / 3.2.P.2.3：在控制策略摘要中提供模型開發的說明與交叉引用
blocks.en: 3.2.S.2.6 / 3.2.P.2.3: provide the description of model development and cross-references in the control strategy summary

blocks.zh: 3.2.R：若屬高影響模型，提供完整驗證資料
blocks.en: 3.2.R: if it is a high-impact model, provide the full validation data
